summary.headline: Summary of advertising mail received by households in fiscal year 2023.

statements.text: For All households, advertising-received-total was 57286.0 millions of pieces in FY2023.
For All households, advertising-received-total decreased by 8033.0 millions of pieces from the previous year in FY2023.
For All households, advertising-received-total decreased by 17989.0 millions of pieces from 5 years earlier in FY2023, from FY2018 to FY2023.

caveats: Prior to 2007, Standard mail volumes were inflated by about 3 billion pieces due to a double count of Detached Address Labels in the Carrier Cost System, whose volumes are the control for the survey results (FY2008 Table E.2 and FY2016 Table A8-12 notes). The FY2020 A8-12 drops the note but its pre-2007 values are no lower.

Volumes through 2007 were understated by about 2 to 3 billion pieces due to a change in the methodology used by the carrier cost system for estimating deliveries to residential addresses (FY2008 Table E.2 note; also FY2016 Table A8-12). Before 2007 this roughly offsets the Detached Address Label double count; 2007 itself is understated.
Beginning in 2010, diary data were restated because of changes in weighting methodology (Appendix A8 table notes). Values before 2010 use the earlier weighting.

From the FY2024 report, results are published as pieces per household per year, and the survey contractor changed (NuStats to RCF). The FY2024 report restated 2014-2023 on its own basis, so its values for those years can differ slightly from earlier reports (e.g. bills paid by mail in 2014: 34% in FY2023, 33% in FY2024).

FY2025 used a new survey design (renamed the Household Mail Survey); Q1 was still covered by the old survey. Age bands changed to Under 45 / 45-64 / 65+ (previously 18-34 / 35-54 / 55+), and 'Large MSA' was redefined in January 2025 from the top 30 metros to metros of 1 million or more.

summary.headline: Advertising mail received by households fell from FY2000 to FY2023

statements.text: Advertising mail received by households fell by 20,084.0 millions of pieces (-26.0%) from FY2000 to FY2023, across the FY2007, FY2008 and FY2010 methodology breaks.
Advertising mail received by households fell by 28,441.0 millions of pieces (-33.2%) from FY2010 to FY2023, since the FY2010 methodology break.
Advertising mail received by households fell by 26,788.0 millions of pieces (-31.9%) from FY2013 to FY2023.
Advertising mail received by households fell by 17,989.0 millions of pieces (-23.9%) from FY2018 to FY2023.
Advertising mail received by households is projected at 58,560.0 millions of pieces in FY2024, 80% prediction interval 53,030.0 to 64,090.0.
Advertising mail received by households is projected at 56,266.0 millions of pieces in FY2025, 80% prediction interval 49,875.0 to 62,658.0.
Advertising mail received by households is projected at 53,973.0 millions of pieces in FY2026, 80% prediction interval 46,600.0 to 61,347.0.
Advertising mail received by households is projected at 51,680.0 millions of pieces in FY2027, 80% prediction interval 41,963.0 to 61,397.0.
Advertising mail received by households is projected at 49,387.0 millions of pieces in FY2028, 80% prediction interval 38,755.0 to 60,019.0.
